framing.meaning: Coverage classifies each (college, occupation) as Covered / Partial / Gap by whether a feeding program both enrolls and awards. It is the institutional legibility of the gap across the member's colleges.
salience: member-anchored: a generated member×sector view covers only occupations the member already serves with an active program — it does NOT surface greenfield demand in occupations the member does not yet serve. Absence here is not absence of regional demand.

gates.reason: San Mateo County CCD runs no active program feeding this sector's qualifying middle-skill occupations, so a member-anchored coverage view is empty. The region may still have unmet demand in this sector — this view is scoped to occupations the member already serves, not greenfield ones.

not_licensed: The Covered/Partial/Gap thresholds are an explicit classification (enrolled AND awarded = covered; exactly one = partial; neither = gap), not an implied score.

next_moves.rationale: See which sectors this member actually runs programs in.

view_link.note: Opens on the lens with a default selection (view state applies client-side); select the row above to corroborate the figure.
